instant.$description: Theme changes, focus rings, and every duration under prefers-reduced-motion.

fast.$description: Hover and press feedback: colour, border, the button-arrow nudge.

base.$description: Disclosures (details, TOC) and the active-section marker.

slow.$description: One-off confirmations such as a copied state settling. Rare.

plate.$description: The specimen plate's single draw-in on load. Decoration only; never for content.

drift.$description: Time the specimen plate's terrain takes to drift one noise unit, so its lines reshape slowly and continuously. The only looping motion in the system: one plate per page, with a visible pause control, stopped under prefers-reduced-motion. The backdrop doesn't drift.

settle.$description: The backdrop's response time. The home page's contours settle into place over it on arrival and then stay still, and a hill the pointer warms takes about two-thirds of it to rise and twice it to flatten. Under five seconds, so nothing runs long enough to need a pause control; none of it happens under prefers-reduced-motion.

pulse.$description: One full cycle of the specimen plate's outward pulse. The only looping motion in the system; it must have a visible pause control and stop under prefers-reduced-motion.
pulse.$deprecated: Unused since the contour plate; removed in 2.0.0.

enter.$description: Elements appearing: disclosures opening, a toast arriving.

linear.$description: Staggered decoration (the plate's contour draw-in) and progress only. The plate's drift is linear too.

pulse.$description: Symmetric ease for looping decoration (the plate pulse), so growth and shrink feel even. Never for state changes.
pulse.$deprecated: Unused since the contour plate; removed in 2.0.0.

nudge.$description: The only allowed translation: a button arrow moving forward on hover. Text never moves.
